macro_area.label: Legal
macro_area.description: Describe legal position, evidence, rights, occupancy and property administration.

subareas.label: Ownership, Possession and Occupancy
subareas.description: Legal and factual relationships between parties and the property.

dictionary_terms.label: Owner Name
dictionary_terms.description: The name of the owner of the property being sold.

dictionary_terms.label: Owner Pays
dictionary_terms.description: A list of expenses for the property paid for by the owner as opposed to the tenant (e.g., Water, Trash, Electric).

dictionary_terms.label: Ownership
dictionary_terms.description: A text description of the manner in which title to a property is held (e.g., Trust, Corporation, Joint Tenant, Individual).

dictionary_terms.label: Year Built
dictionary_terms.description: The year that an occupancy permit is first granted for the house or other local measure of initial habitability of the build. The type of definition permits an empty value with an attribute noting that it is an unknown date or that the building is new construction. While constraints have not been applied, convention at the time of adoption has this as a four-digit year value.

dictionary_terms.label: Owner Phone
dictionary_terms.description: North American 10-digit phone numbers should be in the format of ###-###-#### (separated by hyphens). Other conventions should use the common local standard. International numbers should be preceded by a plus symbol.

dictionary_terms.label: Possession
dictionary_terms.description: A list defining when possession will occur (i.e., COE, COE+1, etc.).

dictionary_terms.label: Tenant Pays
dictionary_terms.description: A list of services or items that the tenant is responsible to pay.

dictionary_terms.label: Tenant Type
dictionary_terms.description: A pick list describing the current status of tenants or lack of tenants at the property.

dictionary_terms.label: Down Payment
dictionary_terms.description: The down payment amount required by the current owner of the property.

dictionary_terms.label: Fuel Expense
dictionary_terms.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

dictionary_terms.label: Pool Expense
dictionary_terms.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

dictionary_terms.label: Tenant Names
dictionary_terms.description: The names of the tenant(s) that currently reside at the property.

dictionary_terms.label: Listing Terms
dictionary_terms.description: Terms of the listing such as Lien Release, Subject to Court Approval or Owner Will Carry. Also may include options that describe the financing terms that are acceptable to the seller (i.e., Cash, Assumable, FHA, etc.).

dictionary_terms.label: Occupant Name
dictionary_terms.description: The name of the current occupant, if any, of the property being sold.

dictionary_terms.label: Occupant Type
dictionary_terms.description: A field that describes the type of occupant (i.e., Owner, Tenant, Vacant).

dictionary_terms.label: Other Expense
dictionary_terms.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

dictionary_terms.label: Rent Includes
dictionary_terms.description: A list of services or items that the tenant is not responsible to pay.

dictionary_terms.label: Trash Expense
dictionary_terms.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

dictionary_terms.label: Association Yes/No
dictionary_terms.description: Indicates if there a homeowner association. A separate Y/N field is needed because not all associations have dues.

dictionary_terms.label: Occupancy Rate
dictionary_terms.description: Indicates how much space of the property is occupied/leased compared to how much space is available.

dictionary_terms.label: Occupant Phone
dictionary_terms.description: North American 10-digit phone numbers should be in the format of ###-###-#### (separated by hyphens). Other conventions should use the common local standard. International numbers should be preceded by a plus symbol.

dictionary_terms.label: Ownership Type
dictionary_terms.description: The current type of ownership of the business being sold (e.g., Corporation, LLC, Sole Proprietor, Partnership).

dictionary_terms.label: Public Remarks
dictionary_terms.description: Text remarks that may be displayed to the public. In an MLS, it is the field where information is entered for the public. This information is intended to be visible online. This is typically information that describes the selling points of the building and/or land for sale. Local conditions and rules will determine what such content can contain. Generally, any information pertaining to entry to the property, the seller and/or tenant, or listing member contact information is excluded. In other systems, these remarks will be determined by local business rules.

dictionary_terms.label: Additional Rent
dictionary_terms.description: Describes a variety of rent-like cash flows from tenants that are not a part of the traditional base rent.

dictionary_terms.label: Association Fee
dictionary_terms.description: A fee paid by the homeowner to the homeowner association that is used for upkeep of common areas, the neighborhood or other association-related benefits.

dictionary_terms.label: Cable TV Expense
dictionary_terms.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

dictionary_terms.label: Common Interest
dictionary_terms.description: A type of ownership in a property that is composed of an individual lot or unit and a share of the ownership or use of common areas. A Common Interest Development (CID) is usually governed by a recorded set of Covenants, Conditions & Restrictions (CC&Rs).

dictionary_terms.label: Listing Service
dictionary_terms.description: The type or level of service the listing member will be providing to the selling homeowner (e.g., Full Service, Limited Service, Entry Only). This will typically be a single selection.

dictionary_terms.label: Manager Expense
dictionary_terms.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations. This is for an individual manager. Use ProfessionalManagementExpense for a management company.

dictionary_terms.label: Private Remarks
dictionary_terms.description: Remarks that may contain security or proprietary information and should be restricted from public view.

dictionary_terms.label: Association Fee 2
dictionary_terms.description: A fee paid by the homeowner to the second of two homeowner associations that is used for upkeep of common areas, the neighborhood or other association-related benefits.

dictionary_terms.label: Association Name
dictionary_terms.description: The name of the homeowner association.

dictionary_terms.label: Copyright Notice
dictionary_terms.description: A notice of the legal rights of the owner of the information or data.

dictionary_terms.label: Electric Expense
dictionary_terms.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

dictionary_terms.label: Gardener Expense
dictionary_terms.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

dictionary_terms.label: Licenses Expense
dictionary_terms.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

dictionary_terms.label: New Taxes Expense
dictionary_terms.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

dictionary_terms.label: Supplies Expense
dictionary_terms.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

dictionary_terms.label: Total Actual Rent
dictionary_terms.description: Total actual rent currently being collected from tenants of the income property.

dictionary_terms.label: Tax Lot
dictionary_terms.description: A type of legal description for land in developed areas where streets or other rights-of-ways delineate large parcels of land referred to as divided into lots on which homes or other types of developments are built. An example would read "Lot 12 of Block 45 of Tract 3002 of the City of San Dunes, Desert County." Such a description would also reference an official plat filed with the clerk or recorder for that area which shows the location of the block and often the dimensions of the lots therein.

dictionary_terms.label: Tax Block
dictionary_terms.description: A type of legal description for land in developed areas where streets or other rights-of-ways delineate large parcels of land referred to as divided into lots on which homes or other types of developments are built. An example would read "Lot 12 of Block 45 of Tract 3002 of the City of San Dunes, Desert County." Such a description would also reference an official plat filed with the clerk or recorder for that area which shows the location of the block and often the dimensions of the lots therein.

dictionary_terms.label: Tax Tract
dictionary_terms.description: A type of legal description for land in developed areas where streets or other rights-of-ways delineate large parcels of land referred to as divided into lots on which homes or other types of developments are built. An example would read "Lot 12 of Block 45 of Tract 3002 of the City of San Dunes, Desert County." Such a description would also reference an official plat filed with the clerk or recorder for that area which shows the location of the block and often the dimensions of the lots therein.

dictionary_terms.description: The amount of vertical space extending above the commercial property.

dictionary_terms.label: Disclaimer
dictionary_terms.description: Text that serves as the negation or limitation of the rights under a warranty given by a seller to a buyer.

dictionary_terms.label: Pets Allowed
dictionary_terms.description: Indicates whether or not pets are allowed at the property being leased, usually as a list of yes, no and more detailed restrictions/allowances.

dictionary_terms.description: Terms of the listing such as Lien Release, Subject to Court Approval or Owner Will Carry. Also may include options that describe the financing terms that are acceptable to the seller (i.e., Cash, Assumable, FHA, etc.).

dictionary_terms.label: Air Rights Unit
dictionary_terms.description: A pick list of the unit of measurement of vertical space extending above the commercial property (e.g., Square Feet, Square Meters).

dictionary_terms.label: Common Interest
dictionary_terms.description: A type of ownership in a property that is composed of an individual lot or unit and a share of the ownership or use of common areas. A Common Interest Development (CID) is usually governed by a recorded set of Covenants, Conditions & Restrictions (CC&Rs).

dictionary_terms.label: Tax Legal Description
dictionary_terms.description: A type of legal description for land in developed areas where streets or other rights-of-ways delineate large parcels of land referred to as divided into lots on which homes or other types of developments are built. An example would read "Lot 12 of Block 45 of Tract 3002 of the City of San Dunes, Desert County." Such a description would also reference an official plat filed with the clerk or recorder for that area which shows the location of the block and often the dimensions of the lots therein. The text here is also an index into the property as described by the County Recorder.

subareas.label: Documents, Evidence and Compliance Records
subareas.description: Documents and evidence supporting identity, rights, compliance, transactions and technical facts.

dictionary_terms.label: Levels
dictionary_terms.description: The number of levels in the property being sold (e.g., One, Two, Three or More, Multi/Split). A discreet horizontal plane of interior living space (excluding basements).

dictionary_terms.label: License 1
dictionary_terms.description: The license number of the mobile or manufactured home, also known as the Department of Housing label/insignia number. For the first or only unit/section, use License 1 over License 2 or 3.

dictionary_terms.label: License 2
dictionary_terms.description: The license number of the mobile or manufactured home, also known as the Department of Housing label/insignia number. For two units/sections, use License 1 and 2 over License 3.

dictionary_terms.label: License 3
dictionary_terms.description: The license number of the mobile or manufactured home, also known as the Department of Housing label/insignia number. For two units/sections, use License 1 and 2 over License 3.

dictionary_terms.label: Year Built
dictionary_terms.description: The year that an occupancy permit was first granted for the building or some other local measure of initial habitability. An empty value is permitted with an attribute noting that it is an unknown date or that the building is new construction. While constraints have not been applied, convention is a four-digit year value.

dictionary_terms.label: Syndicate To
dictionary_terms.description: When permitted by the broker, the options made by the individual agent on where they would like their listings syndicated (i.e., Zillow, Trulia, Realtor.com, Homes.com, etc.).

dictionary_terms.label: Close Date
dictionary_terms.description: With for-sale listings, this is the date the purchase agreement was fulfilled. With lease listings, it is the date the requirements were fulfilled, such as contract and/or deposit. This is the date entered by the agent reflecting when the change occurred contractually, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the MLS.

dictionary_terms.label: Year Built
dictionary_terms.description: The year that an occupancy permit is first granted for the house or other local measure of initial habitability of the build. The type of definition permits an empty value with an attribute noting that it is an unknown date or that the building is new construction. While constraints have not been applied, convention at the time of adoption has this as a four-digit year value.

dictionary_terms.label: Close Price
dictionary_terms.description: The amount of money paid by the purchaser to the seller for the property under the agreement.

dictionary_terms.label: Disclaimer
dictionary_terms.description: Text that serves as the negation or limitation of the rights under a warranty given by a seller to a buyer.

dictionary_terms.label: Concessions
dictionary_terms.description: Indicates whether or not there are concessions included in the sales agreement (i.e., Yes, No or Call Listing Agent).

dictionary_terms.label: Syndicate To
dictionary_terms.description: When permitted by the broker, the options made by the agent on behalf of the seller, where they would like their listings syndicated (e.g., Zillow, Trulia, Realtor.com, Homes.com).

dictionary_terms.label: On Market Date
dictionary_terms.description: The date the listing was placed on market. Where possible, this date is reflective of the date entered by the agent reflecting when the change occurred contractually, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the MLS.

dictionary_terms.label: Unit Type Type
dictionary_terms.description: A list of floor plans or configurations of an individual unit (e.g., 1 Bedroom, Studio, Loft) in a multi-family or multi-unit development. A relational implementation of UnitTypes must omit the type from the field name and use UnitTypeType to create a vertical representation of the various unit types. Repeating of the word "type" in the field name is intentional.

dictionary_terms.label: Off Market Date
dictionary_terms.description: The date the listing was taken off market. Where possible, this date represents the date entered by the agent, reflecting when the change occurred contractually, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the MLS.

dictionary_terms.label: Withdrawn Date
dictionary_terms.description: The date that the listing was withdrawn from the market. This is not when a listing contract was canceled or closed, but a withdrawal from the market while the contract between the seller and listing agent is still in effect and an offer has not been accepted. This is the date entered by the agent reflecting when the change occurred contractually, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the MLS.

dictionary_terms.label: Documents Count
dictionary_terms.description: The total number of documents or supplements included with the listing.

dictionary_terms.label: Contingent Date
dictionary_terms.description: The date an offer was made with a contingency. The listing remains on market. This is the date entered by the agent reflecting when the change occurred contractually, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the MLS.

dictionary_terms.label: Documents Count
dictionary_terms.description: The total number of documents or supplements included with the listing.

dictionary_terms.label: Document Status
dictionary_terms.description: The statuses a document could be in during a transaction.

dictionary_terms.label: Expiration Date
dictionary_terms.description: The date when the listing agreement will expire. This is the date entered by the agent reflecting when the change contractually occurred or will occur, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the MLS. The expiration date of listings, prior to their expiration, cancellation, sale or lease, is confidential information and should be restricted to the agent and their managers, partners or broker.

dictionary_terms.label: Home Warranty Yes/No
dictionary_terms.description: Indicates whether or not a home warranty is included in the sale of the property.

dictionary_terms.label: Standard Status
dictionary_terms.description: The status of the listing as it reflects the state of the contract between the listing agent and seller, or an agreement with a buyer (e.g., Active, Active Under Contract, Canceled, Closed, Expired, Pending, Withdrawn). This is a single-select field.

dictionary_terms.label: Licenses Expense
dictionary_terms.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

dictionary_terms.label: Special Licenses
dictionary_terms.description: Special licenses required/used by the business being sold (e.g., Beer/Wine, Class H, Professional, Gambling, None).

dictionary_terms.label: Member State License
dictionary_terms.description: The license of the member. Multiple licenses should be separated by a comma and space.

dictionary_terms.label: Back on Market Date
dictionary_terms.description: The date a listing, which had previously gone off market, went back to being on market. This date typically will reflect contractual dates. System timestamp should leverage the term Timestamp rather than Date in the field name.

dictionary_terms.label: Bedrooms Possible
dictionary_terms.description: The sum of BedroomsTotal plus other rooms that may be used as a bedroom but are not defined as a bedroom per local policy.

dictionary_terms.label: Cancellation Date
dictionary_terms.description: The date that the listing contract between the seller and listing agent was canceled. This is the date entered by the agent reflecting when the change occurred contractually, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the MLS.

dictionary_terms.label: Labor Information
dictionary_terms.description: Information about labor laws that are applicable to the business being sold (i.e., Union, Non-Union, Employee License Required).

dictionary_terms.label: Listing Agreement
dictionary_terms.description: The nature of the agreement between the seller and the listing agent (e.g., Exclusive Agency, Open Listing).

dictionary_terms.label: Original List Price
dictionary_terms.description: The original price of the property on the initial agreement between the seller and the seller's broker.

dictionary_terms.label: Public Survey Range
dictionary_terms.description: The range identified by the Public Land Survey System (PLSS).

dictionary_terms.label: Showing Attended Yes/No
dictionary_terms.description: Indicates whether or not this home requires an attended showing (i.e., Yes = licensed agent representing the seller must be present during showing).

dictionary_terms.label: Concierge Service Yes/No
dictionary_terms.description: Indicates whether or not the building offers concierge services.This includes service that provides assistance with personal business, such as making restaurant reservations, coordinating cleaning services and planning events in the community space. This is separate from the staffing in AttendanceType.

dictionary_terms.label: Documents Available
dictionary_terms.description: A list of the documents available for the building. Knowing what documents are available for the property is valuable information.

dictionary_terms.label: Franchise Affiliation
dictionary_terms.description: The name of the franchise to which the broker/office is contracted.

dictionary_terms.label: Documents Available
dictionary_terms.description: A list of the documents available for the property. Knowing what documents are available for the property is valuable information.

dictionary_terms.label: Simple Days on Market
dictionary_terms.description: A simplified version of days on market (DOM) where the calculation is a simple start and end, such as the difference between the listing input or contract date and the date of sale.

dictionary_terms.label: Grazing Permits BLM Yes/No
dictionary_terms.description: Indicates whether or not the property owner has grazing permits from the Bureau of Land Management.

dictionary_terms.label: Listing Contract Date
dictionary_terms.description: The effective date of the agreement between the seller and the seller's broker. This is the date entered by the agent reflecting when the change occurred contractually, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the MLS.

dictionary_terms.label: Number Of Units Leased
dictionary_terms.description: The total number of units currently under a lease agreement.

dictionary_terms.label: Public Survey Section
dictionary_terms.description: The section identified by the Public Land Survey System (PLSS).

dictionary_terms.label: Tax Other Annual Amount
dictionary_terms.description: Any other annual taxes, not including the tax reported in the TaxAmount field, as of the last assessment made by the taxing authority.

dictionary_terms.label: Member State License Type
dictionary_terms.description: The license type of the member.

dictionary_terms.label: Office Corporate License
dictionary_terms.description: An independent license number is issued when an office/firm is a corporation.

dictionary_terms.label: Auction License Number
dictionary_terms.description: The license number for the auction in which the property is available.
